defaultInitPrompt.en:
Hi, I'm AndonQ — Tencent Cloud intelligent customer service ☁️

I can help you with:
🎫 Unified ticket management: list, details, and logs for MC and Group(360) tickets
📋 Requirement/story tracking across the group
🤖 Intelligent Q&A across the full Tencent Cloud product line
☁️ Cloud resource inventory and configuration lookup

Tell me what you're running into, or try: "List my open tickets", "How do I upgrade CVM bandwidth?", "Show me all my COS buckets".

Just Ask AndonQ!
